name: Nassau County, New York (United States)
description: Orange field charged at the centre with the county seal: a golden lion rampant with six spots on a blue shield, in a ring reading NASSAU COUNTY STATE OF NEW YORK.
history: Nassau County is a densely populated and affluent suburban county located on Long Island, immediately to the east of New York City, bordering the Long Island Sound on the north and the open Atlantic Ocean to the south.

features.role: county seal, a rampant lion on blue in a ring reading NASSAU COUNTY STATE OF NEW YORK
